question: Among customers in the 'KAM' or 'LAM' segment who used Euros, identify the one with the highest total gas consumption in October 2013. For this customer, also compute their total consumption across all months of 2013 and return both values: October 2013 consumption and full-year 2013 consumption.

prediction.sql:
WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 = '201310' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS oct_2013_consumption,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS full_year_2013_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_002 IN ('KAM', 'LAM')
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
)
SELECT 
    oct_2013_consumption,
    full_year_2013_consumption
FROM customer_consumption
ORDER BY oct_2013_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1
